instagram.caption:
How to book more service calls for your plumbing, HVAC or electrical business.
ServiceTitan data (participating customers, 12 months to Jan 2026): the top 10% of contractors by revenue book 62% of their inbound lead calls. The rest average 39%.
Invoca's 2026 home services report (calls tracked on its platform): 55% of home services businesses don't ask leads to buy or book the job.

Lead Clinic, Lesson 9: ask on every call, and give two times. Say this:
"Got it, [the problem]."
"We can take care of that."
"I can get a tech there today at [time], or tomorrow at [time]. Which works better?"

Two times, not "when works for you?" One of ServiceTitan's sample call scripts asks it the same way: "Are mornings or afternoons better for you?"
Track it every Friday: booked calls divided by lead calls.
It's a pattern, not proof: ServiceTitan says these behaviors are correlated with higher performance and don't show a cause.

Send this to whoever answers your phone.
What does your team say right before a lead call ends?
Free tools for trade owners: link in bio.
Narrated by an AI version of my own voice.

youtube.title: How to Book More Service Calls (Plumbing, HVAC, Electrical Business)
youtube.description:
How to book more service calls: ask every lead to book, and give two times.
For plumbing, HVAC, electrical and home service business owners.
ServiceTitan, "The Profile of a Top Performer: Four Behaviors That Set the Top 10% of Contractors Apart" (May 19, 2026): top performers (contractors in the 90th percentile of revenue within their trade and market segment) book 62% of their inbound lead calls; the rest average 39%. Aggregated, anonymized data from participating ServiceTitan customers across HVAC, plumbing, electrical, garage door, water treatment and other specialty trades, trailing 12 months through January 2026. ServiceTitan says these behaviors are correlated with higher performance and do not show a cause. https://www.servicetitan.com/toolbox/state-of-the-trades/trends/top-performer-profile
Invoca, "The Invoca Home Services Lead Conversion Benchmarks Report 2026" (July 2026): 55% of home services businesses don't ask leads to buy or book the job. Anonymized data from phone calls tracked and analyzed by the Invoca platform across nine home services sub-industries, including HVAC and plumbing. https://invoca.com/reports/the-invoca-home-services-lead-conversion-benchmarks-report-2026
ServiceTitan, "How HVAC Call Scripts Help Boost Booking Rates (With Examples)" (Feb 13, 2024), sample script line: "Are mornings or afternoons better for you?" https://www.servicetitan.com/blog/hvac-call-scripts

Say this on every lead call:
1. "Got it, [the problem]."
2. "We can take care of that."
3. "I can get a tech there today at [time], or tomorrow at [time]. Which works better?"
Then track it every Friday: booked calls divided by lead calls.

Send this to whoever answers your phone.
More Lead Clinic lessons on the channel.
Free tools for trade owners at proofnotfluff.com
Narrated by an AI version of my own voice.
